item.title: Travis Scott & James Blake Reunite for ‘The Odyssey’ Soundtrack Closer ‘When I’m Home’: Listen
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: Welcome to the latest update from Billboard! Today, we're talking about Travis Scott's exciting new venture into Hollywood. The rapper has made his film debut in the highly anticipated movie, The Odyssey, directed by the one and only Christopher Nolan.
[Short music transition]
Host: Not only does Travis Scott star in the film, but he's also featured on the soundtrack, teaming up with James Blake and Ludwig Göransson on the haunting track "When I'm Home". This song plays during the movie's ending credits and reflects the turbulent journey of Odysseus from Homer's ancient Greek poem.
[Short music clip from "When I'm Home"]
Host: In the film, Travis Scott plays the role of a bard, reciting epics and stories from ancient Greece. He's part of an all-star cast, including Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Zendaya, to name a few. This isn't the first time Travis Scott has collaborated with Christopher Nolan, though. He previously worked on the soundtrack for Tenet in 2020, creating the track "The Plan".
[Short music transition]
Host: According to Nolan, he chose Travis Scott for The Odyssey because he wanted to nod to the idea of oral poetry, which is similar to rap. Travis Scott himself said he was thrilled to join the project after getting a call from Nolan, and the rest, as they say, is history.
[Closing music starts playing]
Host: That's all for today's update. Be sure to check out "When I'm Home" and catch The Odyssey in theaters now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one! [Closing music continues to play until the end]
